m.q: Add the eight-bit values 00010110 and 00001101, showing the carry where needed. [4 marks]
st: Align both eight-bit values. Start at the right-hand column with no carry.
0 + 1 = 1 in binary. Write 1; no carry out.
1 + 0 = 1 in binary. Write 1; no carry out.
0 + 1 + 1 (carry in) = 10 in binary. Write 0; carry 1 left.
1 + 0 + 1 (carry in) = 10 in binary. Write 0; carry 1 left.
0 + 0 + 1 (carry in) = 1 in binary. Write 1; no carry out.
0 + 0 = 0 in binary. Write 0; no carry out.
0 + 0 = 0 in binary. Write 0; no carry out. Result: 00100011 (35).
